name: Kawasaki KDX200
engine: 198 cc liquid-cooled two-stroke single, carb, oil injection or premix
intro: Kawasaki's two-stroke enduro bike. Light, simple and usually ridden hard in the woods.

add.title: Check compression and the top end
add.instructions: Do a compression test. Low numbers mean the piston and rings are due. Look at the piston through the exhaust port for scoring.
add.reason: A tired top end is the most common problem on a used two-stroke.

recallNote: Any recalls on bikes this old were closed long ago.
